title.zh: 文明与家园：中华文化与核心价值观

clips.send: Chinese culture. “Long in history, broad and profound”. Created together by all of China’s ethnic groups over thousands of years. It includes writing, poetry, philosophy, festivals, medicine, architecture, opera, crafts. It is called the root and soul of the Chinese nation.

clips.send: The national spirit. Patriotism at the core. Textbook definition: a great national spirit of unity, love of peace, hard work and courage, and ceaseless self-improvement — with patriotism at its core. It takes new forms in each period: the Long March spirit, the “two bombs, one satellite” spirit, the crewed spaceflight spirit, the women’s volleyball spirit, the fight against COVID-19.

clips.send: The Core Socialist Values. Three levels, four words each. Set out nationally in 2012, the 12 words answer three questions: what kind of country, what kind of society, what kind of citizen? Tap a word, then tap the level you think it belongs to (or drag it). clips.send: Forbidden City. 24 Ming and Qing emperors lived here. It covers about 720,000 square meters — the largest and most complete ancient palace complex still standing in the world, held together by wooden joints instead of nails.
clips.text: Forbidden City. 24 Ming and Qing emperors lived here. It covers about 720,000 m² — the largest and most complete ancient palace complex still standing in the world, held together by wooden joints instead of nails.

clips.send: Temple of Heaven. Today: Beijing. Ming and Qing emperors came here to worship Heaven and pray for good harvests. The round Hall of Prayer is built without a single nail.

clips.send: Common mix-up: The core of the national spirit is patriotism (爱国主义) — not “hard work” or “unity”.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Confidence is not arrogance: rejecting all foreign culture, or worshipping it, are both mistakes named in the textbook.

clips.send: Cultural confidence. “A more basic, deeper, more lasting force”. Being confident in your own culture while respecting and learning from others. The textbook: cultural confidence is a more basic, deeper and more lasting force in the development of a country and a nation. It comes from knowing your culture’s history and its achievements today.

clips.send: Where the values come from. Culture, virtues, national spirit, confidence. The textbook says the core values grow out of China’s fine traditional culture. Drag the slider through 3,000 years, then click the four boxes in the chain.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Students often put 民主 (democracy) and 法治 (rule of law) on the wrong level. Democracy is a goal of the nation; rule of law is an orientation of society.

clips.send: Traditional virtues. The essence of Chinese culture. Honouring parents and respecting teachers; honesty; diligence and thrift; helping others; love of country. Sayings students learn: “Do not do to others what you would not want done to you” (Confucius). Virtues are passed on by doing, starting with small things.

clips.send: 价值观从哪里来。文化，美德，民族精神，文化自信。教材指出：社会主义核心价值观植根于中华优秀传统文化。拖动时间滑块走过三千多年，再点击链条上的四个方框。

clips.send: 中华传统美德。中华文化的精髓。孝敬父母、尊师重教、诚实守信、勤俭节约、助人为乐、精忠报国……。学生熟知的名言：“己所不欲，勿施于人。”（孔子）。美德的力量在于践行，要从小事做起。

clips.send: 中华文化。源远流长、博大精深。中华文化是中华各族人民共同创造的。汉字、诗词、哲学思想、传统节日、中医药、建筑、戏曲、工艺……内容极为丰富。中华优秀传统文化是中华民族的根和魂。

clips.send: 民族精神。以爱国主义为核心。教材表述：以爱国主义为核心的团结统一、爱好和平、勤劳勇敢、自强不息的伟大民族精神。在不同时期有不同表现：长征精神、“两弹一星”精神、载人航天精神、女排精神、抗疫精神等。

clips.send: 文化自信。更基本、更深沉、更持久的力量。对自己民族的文化充满自信，同时尊重、学习其他民族的优秀文化。教材表述：文化自信是一个国家、一个民族发展中更基本、更深沉、更持久的力量。文化自信来自对中华文化历史的了解和对当代成就的认同。
